qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with MD Community Medicine/Master of Public Health/Master of Applied Epidemiology/India-EIS/MBA(Disaster Management), MBBS with PG Diploma in Disaster Management, MBBS with MD/MPH/MBA(Disaster Management)/PGDDM, BDS with MPH/MBA(Disaster Management)/PGDDM, MSc Biostatistics/MSc Statistics/MSc Bioinformatics, Master's degree in Geospatial Science/Geography/GIS/Geoinformatics/Environmental Studies, MCA/BTech Computer Science/BCA, MSc Environmental Science/MPH/PhD, Graduate with Diploma in Computer Applications
qualification.details: Team Leader (Public Health): MBBS with MD Community Medicine/Master of Public Health/Master of Applied Epidemiology/ India-EIS / MBA(Disaster Management) or equivalent course with 5 year experience or MBBS with PG Diploma in Disaster Management with 10 years experience. Necessary weightage shall be given to those with Field Epidemiology related degrees or certifications. Public Health Consultant: MBBS with MD/MPH/MBA(Disaster Management)/PGDDM or BDS with MPH/MBA (Disaster Management) /PGDDM with 5 year experience. Technical Officer (Data Analysis): MSc Biostatistics / MSc Statistics / MSc Bioinformatics with 2 years experience with at least 60% marks in qualifying exam. Desirable: Certification in Data Analytics. GIS Specialist (HEOC): Master's degree in Geospatial Science or a related field such as Geography, GIS, Geoinformatics, Environmental Studies with 2 years experience with at least 60% marks in qualifying exam. Desirable: Proficiency in industry-standard GIS software (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Desktop, QGIS, Global Mapper). IT Specialist (HEOC): MCA/BTech Computer Science with 2 years experience as Programmer/computer applications developer or BCA with 3 years experience as Programmer/computer applications developer. Desirable: Certification related to Networking. Environmental Health Specialist (HEOC): MSc Environmental Science / MPH / PhD with experience in areas related to Environmental Health. Desirable: 2 years experience in Environmental Health related field. Multi Task Operator (HEOC): Graduate in any Discipline and Diploma in Computer Applications. Desirable: Certification related to typing, data entry, MS Office / Spreadsheets. Skill sets required - Thorough knowledge in English & Malayalam.

salary_details.public health consultant: Rs.78,000/- per month (MBBS) or Rs.55,250/- per month (BDS)

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM Kerala Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM Kerala to complete the application. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for NHM Kerala Recruitment 2026 is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Team Leader (Public Health) post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Team Leader (Public Health) post. However, the total number of vacancies across all advertised posts is 8.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for NHM Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 250/-. This fee needs to be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Team Leader (Public Health) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Team Leader (Public Health) position is Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. Other posts have different salary structures as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Team Leader (Public Health) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Team Leader (Public Health) post is MBBS with MD Community Medicine/Master of Public Health/Master of Applied Epidemiology/ India-EIS / MBA(Disaster Management) or equivalent with 5 years of experience, or MBBS with PG Diploma in Disaster Management with 10 years of experience.

faq.answer: The selection process for the NHM Kerala Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.
